en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3490 - Umar, the companion of al-Karabis, narrated from Abu Abdullah (as), regarding a man who entered into a mukataba (a contract of emancipation) with his slave and stipulated that the slave's inheritance would belong to him (the master).
This case was presented to Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as) , who invalidated the condition and said:
"The condition of Allah (swt) precedes your condition."
